name: Spirit Binding
body:
School conjuration (calling) [see text]; Level druid 6, shaman 6, witch 6

Targets up to three outsider, fey, or incorporeal undead, totaling no more than 12 HD, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart when they appear

This spell functions as lesser spirit binding, except it can call and bind up to 12 HD of such creatures. Each creature gets a saving throw, makes an independent attempt to escape, and must be individually persuaded to aid you.
